messages:
jamie-peopleops: FYI we received a candidate report that their resume attachment (with redacted phone number) appeared unredacted in a calendar invite for an interviewer. Noticed ~09:05.

Drew-recruiter: Oh no. Candidate flagged it to recruiting. Which pipeline produced the calendar item? Looks like the ATS attachment URL was rendered in the invite body.

ats-bot: webhook-delivery: event=INTERVIEW_CREATED id=evt_unq334 time=2026-03-23T09:03:12Z dest=scheduler-service

Tana-ops: I pulled the invite content from calendar logs: the invite body included the file URL + a transient pre-signed link. The ATS recently changed attachment handling to include a full-text preview parameter. That preview bypassed our redaction step.

mike-eng: If preview param is present, our sanitizer doesn't fetch the attachment and so doesn't strip PII. Short-term: block preview param at the proxy and remove it from outgoing invite bodies. I can push a quick config rule to the attachments proxy.

nora-talent: We need messaging for interviewers: do not open attachments if candidate asks for redaction, and avoid sharing screenshots. Also need to update the interviewer training module about checking for PII in attachments.

jamie-peopleops: Agreed. Immediate actions: (1) @mike-eng apply proxy rule to strip preview param (ETA 20m); (2) People Ops send a brief note to scheduled interviewers for the next 48h asking them not to access attachments if candidate requested redaction; (3) run a search for invites in last 24h containing attachments and redact or resend sanitized invites to affected interviewers; (4) open a vendor ticket to require attachment preview to be disabled for redacted resumes.

mike-eng: Proxy rule applied to staging, rolling to prod now. Rule: drop query param preview=true and replace attachment body with sanitized link token. PR #4217.

ats-bot: proxy-deploy: attachments-proxy v2.3.1 -> rolling deploy started.

Drew-recruiter: I'll notify the candidate and apologize; will confirm whether they want People Ops to reach out to interviewers directly.

Tana-ops: Running a quick audit: found 9 invites in last 18h with attachment previews. I'll redact the invite bodies and send updated invites marked "(sanitized)". Will need calendar write perms.

jamie-peopleops: People Ops message drafted and posted to #interviewer-oncall and emailed those scheduled this week. Wording: "If a candidate asked for redaction, do not open attachments in the invite; contact People Ops for sanitized copy."

nora-talent: I'll add a one-slide update to the interviewer training and include a checklist item: verify attachment redaction status before downloading. We'll include a short example of what to look for in the invite body.

mike-eng: Prod proxy rollout completed. No further deliveries with preview param. Audit job redacted 9 invites and resent updated invites at 09:34.

jamie-peopleops: Closing actions: vendor follow-up ticket created (VEND-1198) to add a flag on ATS side to mark attachments as "redacted" and disable previews; training update scheduled for tomorrow; candidate notified and offered outreach. If anyone sees an unredacted attachment after 10:00 PST, tag me. :white_check_mark:

Drew-recruiter: Thanks team. I'll follow up with the candidate and confirm they're satisfied.

jamie-peopleops: Appreciate the quick turnaround.
